items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: And there was Dave Carey’s Jazz Band, which was quite well known, and the Apex Stompers.

ctx.x: Did you ever make any money doing it?

We played youth clubs and school things. So what you might get was beer and sandwiches. I don’t think anyone ever paid us actual money, but they kind of said come along and play and you can have as much beer to drink or you can have as much food as you want, or something like that. And the irony of it was that we’d got just about our real professional breakthrough, if that was going to be it, when we were named as the interval band at a dance in the center of London, where there was a quite well known jazz band…
You said you were the interval band, the relief band, is that what they called you?
